breve: Abstract base class for interacting with socket streams.
descricao: StreamPeerSocket is an abstract base class that defines common behavior for socket-based streams.

metodos.desc: Returns the status of the connection.
Polls the socket, updating its state. See 'get_status'.

constantes.desc: The initial status of the StreamPeerSocket. This is also the status after disconnecting.
A status representing a StreamPeerSocket that is connecting to a host.
A status representing a StreamPeerSocket that is connected to a host.
A status representing a StreamPeerSocket in error state.
